question: Who among the following won the UK children’s book award in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jasbinder Bilan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India-born author Jasbinder Bilan__ has bagged a coveted **UK children's book award** for her debut novel '__Asha and the Spirit Bird__'.
 
• Bilan will receive **5,000 pounds as the winner of the award.**
